newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BREMEN BUY NORWAY STRIKER FLO FROM AARHUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BREMEN BUY NORWAY STRIKER FLO FROM AARHUS.

text.p: German first division side Werder Bremen have signed Norway striker Havard Flo, the leading scorer in the Danish league, from Aarhus for an undisclosed sum, the club said.
Flo, who has signed until the year 2000, was due to play in Norway's World Cup qualifier against Hungary on Wednesday night in Oslo.
In a statement late on Tuesday, Bremen said Flo would not be able to turn out for them in Saturday's home match against Schalke because he could not be registered in time.

Flo's signing came just one day after Bremen transferred Argentine international midfielder Rodolfo Esteban Cardoso to Hamburg on loan until the end of the season, with an option to buy him for four million marks ($2.6 million).
Cardoso had lost his first-team place in Bremen after the return of Austrian playmaker Andreas Herzog from Bayern Munich.
